content: Homebrew tap auto-update on release. Two established action patterns: (1) mislav/bump-homebrew-formula-action@v4 - pure GitHub API, no brew install; inputs formula-name, formula-path, homebrew-tap (defaults Homebrew/homebrew-core; set to OWNER/homebrew-TAP for a personal tap), tag-name, download-url (defaults to the repo's archive/refs/tags/<tag>.tar.gz), download-sha256 (auto-computed by fetching the archive), create-pullrequest/create-branch which default to FALSE when the token can push directly to base-branch. Requires COMMITTER_TOKEN env, docs specify a classic PAT with repo + workflow scopes because it writes to an external repo. (2) dawidd6/action-homebrew-bump-formula - wraps brew bump-formula-pr, needs a PAT with public_repo + workflow because it forks the tap and opens a PR; supports no_fork and tap: USER/REPO, plus a livecheck mode. Token guidance: GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write to another repo, so a PAT or GitHub App token is mandatory. Homebrew Discussion #5129 resolution: a GitHub App installation token DOES work but only via 'brew bump --no-fork' (plain bump-formula-pr fails with 'Resource not accessible by integration'). Discussion #4389: fine-grained PATs have known failures with brew bump-formula-pr. actions/create-github-app-token@v3 is the standard GitHub App path (client-id + private-key -> token), token expires after 1 hour, works with actions/checkout token: input. For a PERSONAL tap, a direct checkout-with-token + sed + commit + push is a legitimate widely-used pattern; the only hard requirement is a non-default token with contents:write on the tap repo.
